ArgonTest.Name: Type lambda
ArgonTest.InputSource:
module _
import Argon.Core::*
trait Functor(erased F: fn type -> type) public def _.map (token A: type) (token B: type) (f: fn A -> B) (input: F A): F B = abstract end
def intToStringInFunctor (erased F: fn type -> type) (f: Functor F) (fInt: F Int): F String = f.map Int String (|i| i.to_s()) fInt
record ValueBox(token T: type) value: T end
instance ValueBoxFunctor: Functor ValueBox
public override def _.map (token A: type) (token B: type) (f: fn A -> B) (input: (ValueBox A).boxed): (ValueBox B).boxed = ValueBox B { value: f input.value }
end
proc main(): () do let valueBoxFunctor = ValueBoxFunctor
let sBox = intToStringInFunctor ValueBox valueBoxFunctor (ValueBox Int { value: 88 })
puts sBox.value
end
